name: Customizable Rotating Reusable Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Made from high-quality 3mm thick plywood or acrylic, depending on the version.

- The structure is securely reinforced with glue or hook-and-loop dots for flexibility and durability.

- The rotating mechanism and support stand are crafted from 4mm thick wooden skeleton, ensuring stability and longevity.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

- Available in three convenient sizes to suit your needs:

8 x 8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm

10 x 10 inches ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm

12 x 12 inches ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm

- The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:

Utilizes high-quality UV printing technology to ensure sharp, vibrant, and long-lasting images.

Customizable to print on one side or both sides for added functionality.

 

  • Functionality & Usage:

Designed with reusable writable whiteboard sections, allowing you to fill in details like name, date, age, favorite things, future ambitions, and teacher’s name using dry-erase markers.

The rotating flower-shaped axis makes it fun and interactive for kids to flip between different sides.

Ideal for creating a fun photo prop or keepsake for children’s school milestones.

 

  • Perfect Gift for All Occasions:

Make every school milestone memorable with this beautifully designed, reusable signboard. Perfect for capturing those special “First Day” or “Last Day” school moments!

This sign makes a thoughtful and practical gift for: Back to School, Graduation, Birthdays, Baby Showers, Teacher Appreciation, or just to celebrate growth and new beginnings!

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging:  1x Wood Sign , 1x Wooden Stand, 1 x Long jute twine, 2xMetal hooks

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
